sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 1280x1024, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 25 mK; optical: 1/1.8in progressive-scan CMOS
features: thermal & optical bi-spectrum sphere positioning system for perimeter protection with human/vehicle classification
optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 10 to 800 mm (80x) zoom lens with laser illuminator up to 3000 m
thermal detector: uncooled VOx, 1280x1024, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 25 mK

release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD95C8-150ZE4FL is a thermal & optical bi-spectrum sphere positioning system pairing a 1280x1024 uncooled thermal module with a 4 MP optical zoom channel and 3000 m laser illuminator, providing intelligent perimeter protection plus fire and smoke detection. Verified against the official HikMicro datasheet HM-TD95C8-150ZE4FL_W_Datasheet_20250923.pdf.
